rca of the issue: iter230 root cause (PDF non-determinism) fixed by (a) setting SimpleDocTemplate.invariant=True + reportlab rl_config.invariant=1 during build to suppress /CreationDate + /ModDate metadata, and (b) passing a deterministic 'as of' date derived from payload.extracted.period_end into footer_block so the visible footer text is stable.
